name: Retroquisitor (Legendary Inquisitor Archetype)
body:
The key to the future is understanding the past. While still fully committed to their religion, retroquisitors are fanatical devotees of learning, particularly in matters of history and languages. Lifelong students of lore, retroquisitors are more likely to inundate a librarian with questions than a tortured prisoner.

Class Skills: A retroquisitor loses Disguise as a class skill and gains Linguistics instead.

This alters class skills.

Inquisitive Knowledge (Ex)

A retroquisitor adds half her class level (minimum 1) to all Knowledge skill checks and may make all Knowledge skill checks untrained.

This replaces monster lore.

Detect Significance (Sp)

At 2nd level, at will, a retroquisitor can use comprehend languages, cultural adaptation, detect secret doors, or identify at will. She can only use one of these at any given time.

This replaces detect alignment.

Loremaster Secrets

A retroquisitor gains a secret, as the loremaster prestige class feature, at levels 8, 11, 14, and 17. Her level plus Wisdom modifier determines which secrets she can choose. She can’t choose the same secret twice.

This replaces second judgment, stalwart, exploit weakness, and slayer.

True Lore (Ex)

At 16th level, a retroquisitor’s knowledge becomes vast indeed. Once per day a retroquisitor can use her knowledge to gain the effect of a legend lore spell or an analyze dweomer spell. If used to create a legend lore effect, this ability has a casting time of 1 minute, regardless of how much information is already known about the subject in question.

This replaces third judgment.
